uncited: *   **Reconstruction Volume:** A real-space tensor representing the 3D or 2D object.
*   **Projection Data:** A tensor representing the 2D projections in RFFT format.
Positive shift values move image contents along the positive axis direction.
*   **Even Dimensions:** All spatial dimensions must be even.
*   **Batch Broadcasting:** The batch dimension $B$ can be 1 or match the reconstruction batch size.
